title: Paper v2 live TDX minute fetch retry policy terminal-fails whole session on single fetch error
description:
A TDX minute data fetch failure for one live symbol/date caused the entire Paper v2 LIVE_ONLY session to terminal-fail at 2026-05-14 14:45. The error was DATA_UNAVAILABLE with symbol=300970.SZ and trade_date=2026-05-14.

Impact: a transient TDX fetch issue, single-symbol outage, or recoverable provider error can terminate the whole simulated live portfolio. Live simulation should distinguish retryable provider failures from unrecoverable data integrity failures and should keep state observable while preventing fake fills.
reproduce_command: Run/inspect Paper v2 live session psess_4ae1b8aa651b46cd9f418989a328df74: session_events contains SESSION_FAILED with message 'TDX minute data fetch failed' and context symbol=300970.SZ, trade_date=2026-05-14.
required_verification: Define retryability policy for TDX minute fetch failures: transient provider failure, single-symbol missing data, and unrecoverable full-market unavailability are distinct.
Regression test proves retryable TDX minute fetch errors move the session to a waiting/retryable state without generating fake fills.
Regression test proves unrecoverable data integrity failures still fail fast with structured DATA_UNAVAILABLE context.
closure_requirements: Live session no longer terminal-fails on the first retryable single-symbol TDX minute fetch failure.
Dashboard and errors show retryable waiting state clearly to operators.
No implicit fallback to historical/QE/backtest data is introduced.
non_goals: Do not use QE backtest pred.pkl, factor cache, Qlib bin, or diagnostic artifacts for live fills.
Do not fabricate prices or fills when TDX data is unavailable.
Do not weaken strict causality for live minute processing.

events.note: Created from production Paper v2 live-session diagnostic after 2026-05-14 live simulation failure.
